findings.result: daemon.run extracts assignment.traceContext; baseOptions captures its active carrier once and supplies both task-owned preparation and final start. No daemon-global or previous-run carrier is introduced.

Opted-in preparation adds only a separate AsyncLocalStorage startup timing scope. It creates no OTel root, timer or remote request. Phase collection is bounded, closes on resolve/reject and preserves run hash/harness. Supervisor emits only a matching receipt on agent_start success/error; it does not rebase early intervals onto the later stage.

Existing binding, single-consume, current local lease, checkout/final-options and pre-input verification fences remain. Abort/cancel drains only the owned spare/group; ordinary fallback remains restricted to actual project_settings_not_claimable. Partial messages and per-message numeric metrics remain in the consumed SDK loop.

Native receipt projection, model/usage/TTFT, per-child loopback configuration, CLI OTEL override/unset order, captured callback carrier, collector terminal receipt/drain and non-blocking queue flush are unchanged in the protected modules below.

Ordinary starts still require complete successful cli_init. A provided preparation receipt additionally must match the exact run/harness, own clock, both prewarm and final cli_init, and be nontruncated/successful; invalid or incomplete supplied proof cannot fall back to the old check. Reporting keeps preparation and stage origins separate and does not sum overlapping intervals.

New clone/fetch helper consumes only the already prepared task token, appends local process Git settings, scopes the helper to github.com and keeps the token in env rather than literal helper/config text. Existing prepared/local and legacy branches remain. Base64 Basic credential masking is covered by the locally run journal regression. Real loopback smart-HTTP redirect/auth tests were read but not rerun here.

Explicit/Decision custom fixed Profiles re-read the exact frozen candidate rather than enumerate unrelated candidates. Existing owner/share/catalogue checks and source row lock remain. This changes source selection work, not generation trace fields or release evidence; root owns its targeted Node tests.
